subject: Render TESSERA R4 maps 2017–2025 for the fire tab
description: Tobias decided on 2026-11-06 that the Brand — Kårbölebranden tab gets TESSERA R4 land-cover maps for every year 2017–2025 with a year selector, NMD 2023 next to NMD 2018 for comparison, and that 2025 uses HR-VPP 2024, clearly labelled. Add a reproducible CPU job on ICE (server dry run, created only on Tobias's go) that renders the AOI per year through the service's TESSERA R4 path, with HR-VPP gaps for 33VWJ filled via WEkEO into a separate directory (r10 pins /data/vpp_wekeo/index.json), plus the MANIFEST. Not in scope: Prithvi (unpublished until the paper), the service itself. Review: Codex or owner.
